adm.logCapacity.page.title: Caps on the number and size of logs
adm.logCapacity.page.subtitle: Each log class may have a cap on rows and size. Technical logs over the cap are archived to a hashed file and then removed; the business audit trail is only measured and alerted, never removed by a job.

adm.logCapacity.form.hintTechnical: The next night the part over the cap is archived to a hashed file and then removed, down to 90% of the cap. A row younger than its retention rule, or under a legal hold, is never removed.

eqp.list.title: Project equipment procurement
eqp.list.subtitle: Plan, result of the choice of contractor, contract value and disbursement of each equipment line, within the scope of your unit.
eqp.list.empty: No equipment line in your scope yet.
eqp.list.caption: Equipment lines and their progress from plan to disbursement
eqp.guide.title: How to get data
eqp.guide.never: No file of the national bidding network has been applied, so packages and network codes are missing.
eqp.guide.age: The last file was applied {hours} hours ago.
eqp.guide.pending: The file layout is a working assumption waiting for the official sample. It can be trialled but not accepted.
eqp.guide.step.DOWNLOAD: Download the plan and result files from the national bidding network (the system never connects by itself).
eqp.guide.step.UPLOAD: Upload the file on the bidding network import screen.
eqp.guide.step.DRY_RUN: Run a dry run to see what each row would do; nothing is written.
eqp.guide.step.APPLY: Apply the file (each file is applied once).
eqp.guide.step.LINK: Link the package and the contract to each equipment line.
eqp.form.title: Make an equipment line
eqp.form.hint: The code and the planned value cannot change after the line is made; to change them cancel the line and make a new one.
